name: A Walk Down Chang'an Avenue
source:
You're a university student who's suddenly isekai'd to Tang dynasty Chang'an! Will you use your knowledge to correct historical "inaccuracies"... Or will you make a new friend and learn something new? Take a stroll down Chang'an to find out.

[from [url=https://charycats.itch.io/a-walk-down-changan-avenue]itch.io[/url]]
